test_case.test_name: Parameterized AMDSST8-hour CPU/FPU and85%-memory stress with AVT telemetry
test_case.purpose: Sustain the approved AMD CPU/FPU and memory workload for eight hours while verifying thermal, power, ECC and system stability.
required_package: Licensed checksum-pinned AMDSST and AVT versions with vendor-supported option/path validation
PMM/die-temperature cadence and approved thermal/power/ECC/OOM/watchdog limits
Tracked-process cleanup, setting restoration and invalid-run policy
test_case.test_command: Validate the installed signed/licensed packages and resolve their actual `/opt/AMD/SystemStress` and `/opt/AMD/AVT` paths from package evidence; baseline health; launch the reviewed AMDSST non-GUI8h profile once; capture non-lossy AVT PMM/die-temperature plus OS/BMC/ECC telemetry at the approved cadence; stop on any abort gate; collect final logs and restore recorded settings.
test_case.expected_result: The complete eight-hour run finishes without AMDSST, ECC, hardware, watchdog or system-log error and all telemetry remains within approved limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the entire8h profile, continuous valid telemetry, zero disallowed errors and every approved threshold. A help command, shortened smoke run or missing threshold cannot pass.
safety_gate: No launch until licensed versions/options/paths and limits are validated.
Do not shorten8h or silently reduce85% memory coverage.
Track exact PIDs and never auto-retry a failed stress run.
expected_evidence: Platform/tool identity, license/checksum and validated paths/options
Complete AMDSST8h log and exit state
Abort/threshold verdict, process cleanup and restoration
test_case.recovery: On threshold breach, telemetry loss or AMDSST failure, stop only tracked AMDSST/AVT processes, preserve the last thermal/power/ECC/OOM window and process state, restore the approved pre-run policy, verify cooling and memory health, and require engineer authorization before any new eight-hour run.
